title: Windsurf vs GitHub Copilot: Which AI Code Editor Wins in 2026?
summary: Windsurf vs GitHub Copilot compared head-to-head: pricing, features, AI capabilities, and which fits your workflow in 2026. Plus the full-stack option most developers miss.
body_markdown: So far, yes. Cognition acquired Windsurf for approximately $250 million in December 2025 and has maintained the product's quality and direction. SOC 2 compliance remains intact. The main concern is long-term pricing — Cognition may eventually push users toward their Devin platform as the two products converge. For teams evaluating infrastructure risk,[Blink](https://blink.new/) is worth adding to the comparison — it's purpose-built for the full-stack workflow and doesn't depend on any single editor vendor's roadmap.
